NASB.1: Moreover, the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD'S house which faced eastward. And behold, [there were] twenty-five men at the entrance of the gate, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
NASB.2: He said to me, 'Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and give evil advice in this city,
NASB.3: who say, 'Is not [the time] near to build houses? This [city] is the pot and we are the flesh.'
NASB.4: 'Therefore, prophesy against them, son of man, prophesy!'
NASB.5: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said to me, 'Say, 'Thus says the LORD, 'So you think, house of Israel, for I know your thoughts.
NASB.6: 'You have multiplied your slain in this city, filling its streets with them.'
NASB.7: 'Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of the city are the flesh and this [city] is the pot; but I will bring you out of it.
NASB.8: 'You have feared a sword; so I will bring a sword upon you,' the Lord GOD declares.
NASB.9: 'And I will bring you out of the midst of the city and deliver you into the hands of strangers and execute judgments against you.
NASB.10: 'You will fall by the sword. I will judge you to the border of Israel; so you shall know that I am the LORD.
NASB.11: 'This [city] will not be a pot for you, nor will you be flesh in the midst of it, [but] I will judge you to the border of Israel.
NASB.12: 'Thus you will know that I am the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes nor have you executed My ordinances, but have acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you.'''
NASB.13: Now it came about as I prophesied, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, 'Alas, Lord GOD! Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?'
NASB.14: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
NASB.15: 'Son of man, your brothers, your relatives, your fellow exiles and the whole house of Israel, all of them, [are those] to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Go far from the LORD; this land has been given us as a possession.'
NASB.16: 'Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'Though I had removed them far away among the nations and though I had scattered them among the countries, yet I was a sanctuary for them a little while in the countries where they had gone.''
NASB.17: 'Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the countries among which you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.''
NASB.18: 'When they come there, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
NASB.19: 'And I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within them. And I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
NASB.20: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and do them. Then they will be My people, and I shall be their God.
NASB.21: 'But as for those whose hearts go after their detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down on their heads,' declares the Lord GOD.
NASB.22: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered over them.
NASB.23: The glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood over the mountain which is east of the city.
NASB.24: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to the exiles in Chaldea. So the vision that I had seen left me.
NASB.25: Then I told the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.

ESV.1: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the LORD, which faces east. And behold, at the entrance of the gateway there were twenty-five men. And I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
ESV.2: And he said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and who give wicked counsel in this city;
ESV.3: who say, ‘The time is not near  to build houses. This city is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
ESV.4: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O son of man.”
ESV.5: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and he said to me, “Say, Thus says the LORD: So you think, O house of Israel. For I know the things that come into your mind.
ESV.6: You have multiplied your slain in this city and have filled its streets with the slain.
ESV.7: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the meat, and this city is the cauldron, but you shall be brought out of the midst of it.
ESV.8: You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you, declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.9: And I will bring you out of the midst of it, and give you into the hands of foreigners, and execute judgments upon you.
ESV.10: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel, and you shall know that I am the LORD.
ESV.11: This city shall not be your cauldron, nor shall you be the meat in the midst of it. I will judge you at the border of Israel,
ESV.12: and you shall know that I am the LORD. For you have not walked in my statutes, nor obeyed my rules, but have acted according to the rules of the nations that are around you.”
ESV.13: And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
ESV.14: And the word of the LORD came to me:
ESV.15: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, your kinsmen,  the whole house of Israel, all of them, are those of whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far from the LORD; to us this land is given for a possession.’
ESV.16: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: Though I removed them far off among the nations, and though I scattered them among the countries, yet I have been a sanctuary to them for a while  in the countries where they have gone.’
ESV.17: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.’
ESV.18: And when they come there, they will remove from it all its detestable things and all its abominations.
ESV.19: And I will give them one heart, and a new spirit I will put within them. I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
ESV.20: that they may walk in my statutes and keep my rules and obey them. And they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
ESV.21: But as for those whose heart goes after their detestable things and their abominations, I will  bring their deeds upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
ESV.22: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
ESV.23: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain that is on the east side of the city.
ESV.24: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the exiles. Then the vision that I had seen went up from me.
ESV.25: And I told the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.

NLT.1: Then the Spirit lifted me and brought me to the east gateway of the LORD’s Temple, where I saw twenty-five prominent men of the city. Among them were Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who were leaders among the people.
NLT.2: The Spirit said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who are planning evil and giving wicked counsel in this city.
NLT.3: They say to the people, ‘Is it not a good time to build houses? This city is like an iron pot. We are safe inside it like meat in a pot. ’
NLT.4: Therefore, son of man, prophesy against them loudly and clearly.”
NLT.5: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon me, and he told me to say, “This is what the LORD says to the people of Israel: I know what you are saying, for I know every thought that comes into your minds.
NLT.6: You have murdered many in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
NLT.7: “Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: This city is an iron pot all right, but the pieces of meat are the victims of your injustice. As for you, I will soon drag you from this pot.
NLT.8: I will bring on you the sword of war you so greatly fear, says the Sovereign LORD.
NLT.9: I will drive you out of Jerusalem and hand you over to foreigners, who will carry out my judgments against you.
NLT.10: You will be slaughtered all the way to the borders of Israel. I will execute judgment on you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
NLT.11: No, this city will not be an iron pot for you, and you will not be like meat safe inside it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel,
NLT.12: and you will know that I am the LORD. For you have refused to obey my decrees and regulations; instead, you have copied the standards of the nations around you.”
NLT.13: While I was still prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah suddenly died. Then I fell face down on the ground and cried out, “O Sovereign LORD, are you going to kill everyone in Israel?”
NLT.14: Then this message came to me from the LORD:
NLT.15: “Son of man, the people still left in Jerusalem are talking about you and your relatives and all the people of Israel who are in exile. They are saying, ‘Those people are far away from the LORD, so now he has given their land to us!’
NLT.16: “Therefore, tell the exiles, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Although I have scattered you in the countries of the world, I will be a sanctuary to you during your time in exile.
NLT.17: I, the Sovereign LORD, will gather you back from the nations where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel once again.’
NLT.18: “When the people return to their homeland, they will remove every trace of their vile images and detestable idols.
NLT.19: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them. I will take away their stony, stubborn heart and give them a tender, responsive heart,
NLT.20: so they will obey my decrees and regulations. Then they will truly be my people, and I will be their God.
NLT.21: But as for those who long for vile images and detestable idols, I will repay them fully for their sins. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!”
NLT.22: Then the cherubim lifted their wings and rose into the air with their wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered above them.
NLT.23: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the city and stopped above the mountain to the east.
NLT.24: Afterward the Spirit of God carried me back again to Babylonia, to the people in exile there. And so ended the vision of my visit to Jerusalem.
NLT.25: And I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.

CSB17.2: The LORD <sup>[1]</sup> said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who plot evil <sup>ⓒ</sup> and give wicked advice in this city.
CSB17.3: They are saying, ‘Isn’t the time near to build houses? <sup>[2]</sup> <sup>ⓓ</sup> The city is the pot, <sup>ⓔ</sup> and we are the meat.’
CSB17.4: Therefore, prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man!”
CSB17.5: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on me, and he told me, “You are to say, ‘This is what the LORD says: That is what you are thinking, house of Israel; and I know the thoughts that arise in your mind. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.6: You have multiplied your slain in this city, <sup>ⓖ</sup> filling its streets with them.
CSB17.7: “‘Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: The slain you have put within it are the meat, <sup>ⓗ</sup> and the city is the pot, but I <sup>[3]</sup> will take you out of it. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.8: You fear the sword, <sup>ⓙ</sup> so I will bring the sword against you. <sup>ⓚ</sup> This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.9: I will take you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners; I will execute judgments against you. <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.10: You will fall by the sword, <sup>ⓜ</sup> and I will judge you at the border of Israel. <sup>ⓝ</sup> Then you will know that I am the LORD.
CSB17.11: The city will not be a pot for you, <sup>ⓐ</sup> and you will not be the meat within it. I will judge you at the border of Israel,
CSB17.12: so you will know that I am the LORD, whose statutes you have not followed and whose ordinances you have not practiced. Instead, you have acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you.’” <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.13: Now while I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. <sup>ⓒ</sup> Then I fell facedown and cried out loudly, “Oh, Lord GOD! <sup>ⓓ</sup> You are bringing the remnant of Israel to an end!”
CSB17.14: The word of the LORD came to me again:
CSB17.15: “Son of man, your own relatives, those who have the right to redeem your property, <sup>[4]</sup> <sup>[5]</sup> along with the entire house of Israel — all of them — are those to whom the residents of Jerusalem have said, ‘You are far from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
CSB17.16: “Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: Though I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them <sup>ⓔ</sup> in the countries where they have gone.’
CSB17.17: “Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather you from the peoples <sup>ⓕ</sup> and assemble you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.’
CSB17.18: “When they arrive there, they will remove all its <sup>ⓖ</sup> abhorrent acts <sup>ⓗ</sup> and detestable practices from it.
CSB17.19: I will give them integrity of <sup>[6]</sup> heart <sup>ⓘ</sup> and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone <sup>ⓙ</sup> from their bodies <sup>[7]</sup> and give them a heart of flesh, <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.20: so that they will follow my statutes, <sup>ⓛ</sup> keep my ordinances, and practice them. They will be my people, and I will be their God. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.21: But as for those whose hearts pursue their desire for abhorrent acts and detestable practices, I will bring their conduct down on their own heads.” <sup>ⓝ</sup> This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.22: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, lifted their wings, <sup>ⓐ</sup> and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
CSB17.23: The glory of the LORD <sup>ⓑ</sup> rose up from within the city and stopped on the mountain <sup>ⓒ</sup> east of the city. <sup>[8]</sup> <sup>ⓓ</sup>
CSB17.24: The Spirit lifted me up <sup>ⓔ</sup> and brought me to Chaldea and to the exiles in a vision from the Spirit of God. After the vision I had seen left me,
CSB17.25: I spoke to the exiles about all the things the LORD had shown me.

AMP.1: Moreover, the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the Lord's house, which faced eastward. And behold, at the entrance of the gate there were twenty-five men; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
AMP.2: Then the Spirit said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise evil and give wicked advice in this city,
AMP.3: who say, 'Is not the time near to build houses? This city is [secure just like] the pot and we are the meat [in it].'
AMP.4: Therefore, prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man!"
AMP.5: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said to me, "Say, 'Thus says the LORD, "This is what you think, house of Israel, for I know your thoughts.
AMP.6: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the corpses [of righteous men]."
AMP.7: Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, "Your dead whom you have laid in the midst of your city are the meat and this city is the pot; but I shall force you out of [the security of] it.
AMP.8: You have feared the sword; so I will bring a sword upon you," says the Lord GOD.
AMP.9: And I will bring you out of the midst of the city and hand you over to strangers and execute judgment against you.
AMP.10: You will fall by the sword; I will judge and punish you [in front of your neighbors] at the border of [the land of] Israel; and you will know [without any doubt] that I am the LORD.
AMP.11: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be meat [safe] in it, but I will judge you at the border of Israel.
AMP.12: And you will know [without any doubt] that I am the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes nor have you executed My ordinances, but you have acted in accordance with the ordinances of the nations around you."'"
AMP.13: Now it came about while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell face downward and cried out loudly, "Alas, Lord GOD! Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?"
AMP.14: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
AMP.15: "Son of man, your brothers, your relatives, your fellow exiles and the whole house of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the [present] inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Go far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.'
AMP.16: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, "Though I had removed Israel far away among the nations and though I had scattered them among the countries, yet I have been a sanctuary for them for a little while in the countries to which they had gone."'
AMP.17: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, "I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give [back] to you the land of Israel."'
AMP.18: When they return there, they will remove from it all [traces of] its detestable things and all its repulsive things (remnants of paganism).
AMP.19: And I will give them one heart [a new heart], and put a new spirit within them. I will take from them the heart of stone, and will give them a heart of flesh [that is responsive to My touch],
AMP.20: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and do them. Then they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
AMP.21: But as for those whose heart longs for and follows after their detestable things and their repulsive things [associated with idolatry], on their own head I will repay [them in full for] their [vile] conduct," says the Lord GOD.
AMP.22: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings with the wheels beside them, and the [Shekinah] glory of the God of Israel hovered over them.
AMP.23: Then the glory and brilliance of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and paused over the mountain, [the Mount of Olives] which is east of the city.
AMP.24: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to the exiles in Chaldea (Babylonia). Then the vision that I had seen left me.
AMP.25: Then I told the exiles everything that the LORD had shown me.

NIV.1:
Judgment on Israel’s Leaders
Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that faces east. There at the entrance to the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
NIV.2: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.
NIV.3: They say, ‘Will it not soon be time to build houses? This city is a cooking pot, and we are the meat.’
NIV.4: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.”
NIV.5: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon me, and he told me to say: “This is what the Lord says: That is what you are saying, O house of Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.
NIV.6: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
NIV.7: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.
NIV.8: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign Lord.
NIV.9: I will drive you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners and inflict punishment on you.
NIV.10: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
NIV.11: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.
NIV.12: And you will know that I am the Lord, for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you.”
NIV.13: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Ah, Sovereign Lord! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?”
NIV.14: The word of the Lord came to me:
NIV.15: “Son of man, your brothers—your brothers who are your blood relatives and the whole house of Israel—are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, ‘They are far away from the Lord; this land was given to us as our possession.’
NIV.16:
Promised Return of Israel
“Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’
NIV.17: “Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.’
NIV.18: “They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.
NIV.19: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.
NIV.20: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
NIV.21: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord.”
NIV.22: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
NIV.23: The glory of the Lord went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.
NIV.24:
The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God.
Then the vision I had seen went up from me,
NIV.25: and I told the exiles everything the Lord had shown me.

MSG.1: Then the Spirit picked me up and took me to the gate of the Temple that faces east. There were twenty-five men standing at the gate. I recognized the leaders, Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah.
MSG.2: God said, "Son of man, these are the men who draw up blueprints for sin, who think up new programs for evil in this city.
MSG.3: They say, 'We can make anything happen here. We're the best. We're the choice pieces of meat in the soup pot.'
MSG.4: "Oppose them, son of man. Preach against them."
MSG.5: Then the Spirit of God came upon me and told me what to say: "This is what God says: 'That's a fine public speech, Israel, but I know what you are thinking.
MSG.6: You've murdered a lot of people in this city. The streets are piled high with corpses.'
MSG.7: "Therefore this is what God, the Master, says: 'The corpses that you've piled in the streets are the meat and this city is the soup pot, and you're not even in the pot! I'm throwing you out!
MSG.8: You fear war, but war is what you're going to get. I'm bringing war against you.
MSG.9: I'm throwing you out of this city, giving you over to foreigners, and punishing you good.
MSG.10: You'll be killed in battle. I'll carry out judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you'll realize that I am God.
MSG.11: This city will not be your soup pot and you won't be the choice pieces of meat in it either. Hardly. I will carry out judgment on you at the borders of Israel
MSG.12: and you'll realize that I am God, for you haven't followed my statutes and ordinances. Instead of following my ways, you've sunk to the level of the laws of the nations around you.' "
MSG.13: Even while I was preaching, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. I fell down, face to the ground, and prayed loudly, "O Master, God! Will you completely wipe out what's left of Israel?"
MSG.14: The answer from God came back:
MSG.15: "Son of man, your brothers—I mean the whole people of Israel who are in exile with you—are the people of whom the citizens of Jerusalem are saying, 'They're in the far country, far from God. This land has been given to us to own.'
MSG.16: "Well, tell them this: 'This is your Message from God, the Master. True, I sent you to the far country and scattered you through other lands. All the same, I've provided you a temporary sanctuary in the countries where you've gone.
MSG.17: I will gather you back from those countries and lands where you've been scattered and give you back the land of Israel.
MSG.18: You'll come back and clean house, throw out all the rotten images and obscene idols.
MSG.19: I'll give you a new heart. I'll put a new spirit in you. I'll cut out your stone heart and replace it with a red-blooded, firm-muscled heart.
MSG.20: Then you'll obey my statutes and be careful to obey my commands. You'll be my people! I'll be your God!
MSG.21: " 'But not those who are self-willed and addicted to their rotten images and obscene idols! I'll see that they're paid in full for what they've done.' Decree of God, the Master."
MSG.22: Then the cherubim spread their wings, with the wheels beside them and the Glory of the God of Israel hovering over them.
MSG.23: The Glory of God ascended from within the city and rested on the mountain to the east of the city.
MSG.24: Then, still in the vision given me by the Spirit of God, the Spirit took me and carried me back to the exiles in Babylon. And then the vision left me.
MSG.25: I told the exiles everything that God had shown me.
